item.description:
0.12.1

  • Tunnels: the table says whether a port listens on this Mac or the server, and every blocked tunnel says why.
  • Transfers: the finished list no longer repeats itself, and small files show their size in bytes.
  • Panes: the focus border no longer covers text, and closing a pane asks first if it still has transfers queued.
  • Command suggestions no longer remember access tokens, in addition to passwords.
